corrigendum_rationale.binding_invariant: The production UMSI++ implementation must remain source-faithful. No architecture, weights, preprocessing, resize semantics or native outputs were modified to satisfy a validation gate.
corrigendum_rationale.gate_a_defect: P8 Gate A targeted modern_raw/M_LC_lowcontrast_raw (the intentional negative-control / broken-resize condition produced by keras UpSampling2D with half-pixel-centre semantics) as a positive acceptance requirement. A source-faithful production implementation using legacy-compatible resize (tf.raw_ops.ResizeBilinear, align_corners=False, half_pixel_centers=False) is required to differ from M_LC. Gate A has been demoted to Diag-1 and the positive acceptance criterion is replaced with the pre-registered functional-parity thresholds against the legacy reference (identical to P8 Gate B).
corrigendum_rationale.gate_c_defect: P8 Gate C enforced same_dtype between the native float32 production classification output and a float64 reference produced by an explicit cast in golden/modern_causality.py (lines 78 and 254). The float64 dtype is a serialization convention in the evidence-generation script, not a property of the model or a scientific requirement. Gate C has been demoted to Diag-2 with no dtype requirement. The classification acceptance criterion is replaced by the pre-registered cli_abs_max tolerance (identical to P8 Gate D).
corrigendum_rationale.gate_selection_basis: The corrected acceptance gates (Gate 1 = P8 Gate B logic, Gate 2 = P8 Gate D logic) were selected because they test source-faithful parity with the legacy reference. They were not selected because their P8 outcomes were already known.

observed.alarm_reason: none — negative control is discriminative as expected
observed.negative_control_purpose: Production must NOT reproduce the M_LC broken-resize output. Expected: metrics below positive-parity thresholds.

observed.note: Records cross-environment drift between production float32 output and M_LC float64 reference. No pass/fail verdict.

frozen_thresholds.note: All numeric thresholds are inherited unchanged from the P8 contract and the historical resize-causality pre-registration. No threshold was modified as a result of observing P8 outcomes.

verdict.direct_activation_capture_note: Direct runtime activation capture was not performed in this zero-inference re-evaluation. The combination of: (1) pinned and verified production source SHA, (2) static code-path trace confirming LegacyBilinearUpSampling2D uses tf.raw_ops.ResizeBilinear, (3) near-perfect functional parity with the legacy reference (Gate 1 Pearson > 0.999), and (4) M_LC negative-control discrimination, constitutes sufficient evidence for thesis-level source-faithful validation without direct activation capture. A future P10 run with activation capture would upgrade this from NOT_PROVEN to PROVEN.
verdict.pass_meaning: The immutable P8 production outputs satisfy the corrected, source-faithful acceptance semantics (Gate 1: saliency parity with legacy reference; Gate 2: classification parity with legacy reference; Diag-1: M_LC negative control valid and discriminative). P8's historical FAIL conclusion is not overwritten. No independent new inference or direct activation capture was performed in this re-evaluation.
verdict.saliency_norms_rationale: P9 acceptance gates passed. Production source and weights match P8-pinned identities. Saliency norm computation may proceed.
